name: Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Limited
summary: Sanofi Consumer Healthcare India Limited is a Mumbai-based company founded in 2023 that sells fast-moving consumer healthcare products for allergy relief, well-being and pain management. Brands include Allegra, Combiflam, Avil, DePURA, Festal and Novalgin NU. It sells through distributors, wholesalers, hospitals, pharmacies and e-commerce, and its parent is Opella Healthcare Participations B.V.
